content_fields.title: Enforce trusted hosts and HTTPS-only transport with Starlette middleware (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Install TrustedHostMiddleware and HTTPS enforcement so Host headers are validated and plaintext requests are redirected.
content_fields.finding: Neither TrustedHostMiddleware nor HTTPSRedirectMiddleware is installed, so Host headers are unvalidated and plaintext HTTP is served.
content_fields.current_code:
app = FastAPI(
        title=settings.TITLE,
        description=settings.DESCRIPTION,
        version=settings.VERSION,
        servers=settings.SERVERS,
        root_path=settings.ROOT_PATH,
        docs_url=None,
        redoc_url=None,
    )
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/init_app.py
from starlette.middleware.httpsredirect import HTTPSRedirectMiddleware
from starlette.middleware.trustedhost import TrustedHostMiddleware

app.add_middleware(TrustedHostMiddleware, allowed_hosts=settings.ALLOWED_HOSTS)
if settings.ENVIRONMENT is ENV.PRODUCTION:
    app.add_middleware(HTTPSRedirectMiddleware)
criteria: A plaintext HTTP request in production is redirected to HTTPS.
Allowed hosts come from configuration, not a wildcard.
